title: 盈利翻倍却遭质疑：估值为何比想象低，融资循环说法每周现
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Whatever NVIDIA does, numbers wise, be raised, what is it that they need to say or do to change sentiment right now?
segments.zh: 无论英伟达的业绩数字如何，他们需要说些什么或做些什么来改变当前的市场情绪？

segments.en: Yeah, thank you again for having me here Ed. You know, as Carmen just said, they're doubling earnings here every quarter, right?
segments.zh: 是的，再次感谢你邀请我，Ed。正如Carmen所说，他们每个季度的盈利都在翻倍，对吧？

segments.en: You've got a really acceleration again this quarter, especially versus last year and still the stock is trading in 18, 19 times, 16 times 28 earnings.
segments.zh: 本季度再次加速增长，尤其是与去年相比，但股价仍处于18、19倍，甚至16倍于2028年预期收益的水平。

segments.en: They're going to have to talk about these investments. That circular financing narrative is out there every week.
segments.zh: 他们必须谈论这些**。那种循环融资的说法每周都会出现。

segments.en: You every day you wake up and there's a new every day. There's, you know, that calm team at NVIDIA is the hardest working team.
segments.zh: 每天醒来都有新消息。你知道，英伟达的团队是最勤奋的团队。

segments.en: You've seen in the market today. And so every day they come out with another investment.
segments.zh: 今天市场已经看到了。他们每天都会宣布另一项**。

segments.en: You did, some of them watch this program. Yeah, yeah, yeah. You're the other response to that.
segments.zh: 是的，其中一些人看了这个节目。是的，是的，是的。这是你们的另一个回应。

segments.en: Sorry to interrupt me. They're quite hard working there. So I would say, look, I actually think I read something the other day on the information,
segments.zh: 抱歉打断一下。他们确实很努力。所以我想说，我前几天在The Information上读到一篇文章，

segments.en: which was about how this is a little bit reminiscent to what John Malone did in the 1980s.
segments.zh: 这篇文章提到，这有点像约翰·马龙在1980年代所做的那样。

segments.en: Okay. So if you recall, he was building TCI.
segments.zh: 好的。如果你还记得，他当时在建设TCI。

segments.en: And at the time, that relied on cable networks and he was trying to build a cable TV of what you know today.
segments.zh: 当时，这依赖于有线网络，他试图打造一个如今你所知的有线电视。

segments.en: Of course, that's being cord cutted at this point. But at the time, he was seeding it with investing in discovery, investing in BET, investing in
segments.zh: 当然，现在已经被切断。但当时，他通过**Discovery、BET等频道来培育它。

segments.en: a number of other channels. Turner, we're talking about all these companies now.
segments.zh: 以及其他一些频道，比如特纳，我们现在谈论所有这些公司。

segments.en: The new Paramount, David Zazlov's discovery, Warner.
segments.zh: 新的派拉蒙，大卫·扎斯拉夫的Discovery和华纳。
